sign_off.blocking_on: Not ready for merge. The EIGHTH independent exact-head review returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with a P1: it re-executed 45 of the 47 then-published mutations on isolated repository copies, found NO actual survivor, but proved the published RECORD was false for 30 of them -- entries 18 through 47 each carried a kill set inflated by a constant block of roughly 33 unrelated failing tests. The cause was the /tmp tmpfs exhausting its inode table mid-run (25,117 leaked mkdtemp fixture directories, pushed over the limit by that run's own 94 suite executions), so from entry 18 onward fixture creation failed with ENOSPC and a block of tests was red regardless of the mutation. In that state every mutation scores 'detected' automatically, which is exactly the direction that would conceal a survivor. The record was impossible on its face as well: lane-start.ts mutations claimed to kill execution-packet.test.ts tests, a suite that cannot reach lane-start.ts at all. The same review found the battery was not the union it claimed to be -- the three mutations proving G42/G43/G44 had never been persisted to a definition list. This cycle is EVIDENCE-ONLY under PM directive 5420127581: no source or test file was changed, and the executable/test tree is asserted byte-identical to the reviewed head. The battery was re-run by a runner that fails closed on any infrastructure error rather than scoring it as a kill, with a clean baseline asserted before the run, after every tenth mutation and at the end, an inode floor checked before every mutation, an exact expected test total enforced per suite run, and a structural rejection of any killer reported by a suite that cannot reach the mutated file. Measured at this head: 50 mutations, 50 detected, 0 survivors. Eight of nine rounds have found a defect the previous round installed or missed, so a clean ninth review is not treated by this bundle as a formality.

review_threads.subject: Reserve all recognized contract headings
review_threads.detail: The reserved set omitted guardrails, all four non-goals spellings, and required evidence/evidence, so a nested non-goal was both left in its acceptance ancestor and extracted as a non-goal. Fixed structurally: extraction and reservation now read one table (CONTRACT_FIELD_SPECS) and every extraction site goes through fieldSpec(). A flat list could not express non-goals' prefix matching in any case.

review_threads.subject: Honor fenced code while parsing headings
review_threads.detail: parseSections now tracks fenced blocks and requires at most three leading spaces. A second half not named in the report was found by assertion: sectionItems flattened a fenced block into one whitespace-collapsed line, putting a shell comment on the same line as the command it warns about. sectionItems is now fence-aware.

mutation_testing.method: Each mutation applied to a sha256-verified baseline, both suites run, baseline restored BY FILE COPY (never git checkout) and re-verified by sha256 before the next mutation. Executed by a scripted runner; this block is its JSON output, not a transcription.
mutation_testing.runner: The UNION of every mutation run across every round of this lane (50), re-executed in full at this head. Executed by a scripted runner over the mutation set published in full in the verification.md appendix (sha256 94dae395f2067cd857dc1030a5fbc1733efee4c604d38104db7793c466d306a9); that appendix is self-contained and re-runs this entire battery on a clean checkout. The seventh review found this field naming three different runners across the bundle; it is now one generated string.

mutation_testing.infrastructure_policy: Fail-closed. ENOSPC/EMFILE/ENFILE/ENOMEM, a killing signal, an exit code outside {0,1}, a missing TAP summary, a suite reporting fewer tests than its exact expected total, a free-inode count below the floor, or a killer reported by a suite that cannot reach the mutated file each ABORT the battery. An infrastructure failure is never recorded as a mutation kill.
mutation_testing.clean_baseline_assertions: before the run, after every tenth mutation, and at the end
